about_the_game:
In Evolvania you embody a mysterious, wandering eye on a quest to seize eyedrops.

Venture deep into a colossal creature and discover the mysterious secrets it holds. Explore every corner and crevice hand-drawn with vivid, gruesome detail.

A Haunting, Handcrafted World

Immerse yourself in a bizarre interior landscape of a colossal beast. Every dripping detail and splatter tells a story waiting to be uncovered.

Revolutionary Combat & Fusion Mechanics

Experience classic 2D metroidvania action with a twist. Use the different combinations to experiment and unlock new gruesome abilities and passages within the game world. Evolve in something new: better, faster and stronger!

Diverse and Thrilling Foes

Face a range of enemies, each with its own unique challenge. Learn their secrets, adapt your strategies, and devour them one by one.

Create Your Own Adventure

With our intuitive level editor, transform your journey into a sandbox of creativity. Build your own metroidvania adventure and creatures using all the elements you've encountered in the main adventure.

Step into a world that blends visceral atmosphere with inventive gameplay, where every step forward deepens the mystery of your very existence. Every encounter is an opportunity to evolve.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E5200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 9800GTX+ (1GB)
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 10
  • Additional Notes: 1080p, 16:9 recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 560
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 11
  • Additional Notes: 1080p, 16:9 recommended

short_description: Venture into a colossal creature by merging with the environment and enemies. Evolve and acquire new powers. Evolvania is an hand-drawn metroidvania in which you can play a breathtaking adventure or create your own with a special level editor.
